name: Sagamihara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sagamihara city emblem in crimson: the kanji 相 (sagami) stylised within three interlinked rings arranged as a trefoil.

features.role: Sagamihara city emblem — the kanji 相 within three linked rings
features.symbolism: the linked rings express the harmonious union of the towns that formed the city
